note: Triennial election of the sixteen district electoral divisions of Hillsborough rural district, one member each, polled on 2 June 1949. Two divisions, Maze and Drumbo, were contested; thirteen members were returned unopposed and, with no nomination for Carryduff, its retiring member was deemed re-elected (returning officer's notice of result, Dromore Leader, 11 June 1949, p. 4; round 2, 7 Nov 2026). Returned unopposed.
